capabilities: Open .html and .htm files in a separate desktop web view
Run script-based prototypes such as React, Vue, and ES modules
Zoom between 25% and 300% with a reset control
Find and highlight text forward and backward
Toggle the toolbar interface between English and Chinese
disambiguation: Not a passive reader or sanitizer: it executes HTML scripts and is meant only for trusted local files.
extras: Manual installation only; marketplace availability pending Obsidian review. README stresses security limits: scripts run, no vault-only resource boundary, and browser storage may persist across files in a vault partition.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open and interact with local HTML files (including script-driven prototypes) inside the vault.
summary: Opens trusted local HTML/HTM files in a dedicated desktop web view with zoom, text search, reload, and a collapsible bilingual toolbar.
